institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific thank you messages to the lender community tend to fund faster.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years the business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the duration of business operation or years of professional experience tend to accelerate funding speed for both men and women.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

living-conditions-interaction.title: Mentioning home or living condition improvements accelerates funding for women but slows it for men.
living-conditions-interaction.body: Pitches from women that focus on improving living conditions fund faster, whereas similar mentions in male pitches predict slower funding.

female-education-level-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their education level fund more slowly.
female-education-level-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify the borrower's or their children's education level tend to predict slower funding speed.

female-logistical-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who include specific daily logistics like walking distances may fund more slowly.

male-repeat-borrower-faster.body: Mentioning status as a repeat borrower may accelerate funding for male borrowers.

female-repayment-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a history of previous loan repayment may fund more slowly.

female-diversification-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention diversifying their income or product range may fund faster.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Explicitly stating marital status may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-length-slower.body: Lengthier pitches may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

male-daily-routine-faster.body: Detailed daily routines may accelerate funding for male borrowers.

male-family-roles-slower.body: Mentioning family members and their roles may predict slower funding for male borrowers.

female-age-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund more slowly.

female-existing-business-faster.body: Female borrowers describing an existing business may fund faster than those describing starting a new one.

female-environmental-protection-faster.title: Mentioning the promotion of environmental protection may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-environmental-protection-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation.

female-location-specificity-faster.title: Mentioning a specific town, region, or ancestral traditions may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-location-specificity-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation regarding local currency.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.title: The phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle to make room for new observation regarding pitch length.

demographic-specificity-faster.title: Pitches that include concrete demographic details, including the borrower's age or educational background, tend to accelerate funding speed for both men and women.
demographic-specificity-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by female observations regarding education; confidence fell below 0.35.

female-own-efforts-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining their business through their 'own efforts' may fund more slowly.
female-own-efforts-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle to make room for new female observations.

male-family-emphasis-slower.title: Men who emphasize family roles or use highly descriptive narrative language may fund more slowly, potentially contrasting with the effect for women.
male-family-emphasis-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle to make room for new female observations.

female-pitch-length-slower.title: Pitches from female borrowers that are significantly shorter than others in their pair may fund more slowly.
female-pitch-length-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that lengthier pitches fund more slowly for women.

female-cultural-recognition-faster.title: References to international cultural recognition (e.g., UNESCO) may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-cultural-recognition-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation regarding borrower age.

female-educational-aspirations-slower.title: Mentioning educational aspirations or learning via online tutorials may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-educational-aspirations-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation regarding local currency.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
female-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new observation regarding existing vs new businesses.
